doors.reason: The doorway between the student lounge (room 10) and the kitchen (room 9) exists in the building and is missing from the Revit model. It has no door panel (owner, 2026-11-06, second pass).

The wall across the kitchen (room 9) one metre inside the door from crit room 1 has a pass-through doorway with no door panel, in line with that door; the model shows the wall unbroken, so the door from room 1 led to a dead end.
